geometry_note: FIRMS yearly country archives of 14 countries of South America on cells of 0.5 degrees (not available in the archive: Brazilian I., Southern Patagonian Ice Field); cells with fewer than 10 detections are omitted; border cells are partial. Coarse estimate: the coefficients come from the selected cells themselves and are unreliable for small areas.
filter_note: MODIS 2003-2024 and S-NPP 2012-2024 only (no NOAA-20/21 and no 2025-2026 in this grid); confidence filter and persistent-pixel rule, no `type` filter

filter_profile.name: conf_persistent
filter_profile.description: continuous records (archives + API): confidence ok, persistent pixels removed; `type` ignored so that every platform and period is filtered the same way
